vector<int> sieve(int n) {
    vector<int> a(n + 1, 1);
    a[0] = a[1] = 0;
    for (int i = 2; i <= sqrt(n); i++) {
        if (a[i] == 1) {
            for (int k = 2; i * k <= n; k++) {
                a[i * k] = 0;
            }
        }
    }
    return a;
}

    while (start <= end) {

        if (a[mid] >= v) {
